endings.title: The City Took You
narrative: Your body gave out. The city you tried to save had no more use for you.
But somewhere, a stranger remembered your name.

endings.title: The Quiet Collapse
narrative: It wasn't the dead that got you in the end.
You simply stopped. Sat down. And didn't get back up.
The city moved on without you.

endings.title: Alone in the Ruins
narrative: The city is quieter now — not peaceful, just empty.
You stop counting the days. It doesn't feel like surviving anymore.
endings.epilogue: You scavenge the ruins for another three months before finding a radio signal from the coast.

endings.title: The Last City
narrative: You didn't just survive. You built something.
Forty-three people call this place home now. They argue about rations and watch schedules and who gets the corner room.
Normal problems. Human problems. You never thought you'd be grateful for those.
endings.epilogue: Three years later, another settlement sends a radio signal. They've heard about you.
